ns2:section.sectionText: Students should have taken IS 205 - Programming for Information Problems or have a basic knowledge of a coding language (examples include Python, C++, Java, object-oriented modeling) prior to taking this course. Restricted to Information Sciences majors until 12/1/22 by noon. We will not provide overrides, please wait until the course restrictions are removed. For more information about this major, please visit: http://go.ischool.illinois.edu/BSIS. Questions may be sent to bsis-advising@illinois.edu.
